title: Soldier Shouts Toward Hegseth to Show ‘Respect’ at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
summary: A Pentagon spokesman said the sentinel had “reminded everyone to maintain decorum” after laughter was heard from a group visiting the burial site with the Defense Secretary on Wednesday.
